findings.message: End-of-life date 2027-04-16 violates the 3-month cap (today + 3 months = 2027-01-16). The main application is upstream-sourced (demo-app from Ubuntu archive). No accepted support plan or human CODEOWNERS approval is cited. Reduce end-of-life to 2027-01-16 or earlier, or provide a support plan for maintainer approval.

PPA repository declaration added (canonical-demo/stable) without documentation of which shipped packages, if any, are sourced from it versus the Ubuntu archive. For transparency, document the package provenance for the PPA.

summary: Commit bumped from 0000000000000000000000000000000000000002 to 0000000000000000000000000000000000000003; end-of-life extended from 2026-12-01 to 2027-04-16 on track 1.2-24.04 (edge only). Recipe addition: PPA repository declaration. No parts, services, or base changes.
